shared.CPU: Standard English acronym for the processor, used as-is in Hebrew technical interfaces.
shared.GPU: Standard English acronym for the graphics processor, used as-is in Hebrew technical interfaces.
shared.PID: Operating-system term for the process identifier, kept in Latin script in the Hebrew UI.
shared.ICMP TTL: Network protocol acronym plus its field name, which have no accepted Hebrew form.
shared.Ping TTL: Standard network diagnostic name and field abbreviation, kept in Latin script.
shared.DeepSeek API: Product proper noun together with the API acronym, which stays untranslated.

notes: Only real acronyms and proper nouns that the Hebrew interface keeps in Latin script are listed here. Every remaining message value is written in Hebrew.
